definedness: PartialBytePair defines only low16 encoded byte identities. All upper bits remain undefined. Whole-word stores and UBYTE2/3 reads fail closed; narrow stores retain exact byte identities. Numeric byte formats are claimed only by an actual numeric decoder.
smem_profile: Subword loads retain the conservative DWORD-aligned base requirement; immediate/SGPR byte displacements require natural1/2byte alignment. The native compiler emits U16 kernarg byte offset0x16. Ordinary DWORD SMEM component low-bit behavior remains outside this extension.
